findings.message: This round-4 fix stops the crash on the Team page for a role that has allocations:read but not delivery:read. It is tested with one hand-built case: an HR viewer with viewAs set to undefined, and a stub slot that throws. There is no table over variants, and the test never drives Delivery's real `projectHeaderSlot` (its `load` → `getProject` → `read()`). If the `can(viewer, "delivery:read")` guard is ever moved below `slot.load`, only the stub's throw is exercised. Fix: make the test an `it.each` over at least these cases: HR signed in directly; an Admin using View as HR (`viewAs`); and the real Delivery slot from `setProvided([deliveryManifest])` with the guard path taken.
findings.scenario: An Admin uses View as HR and opens /delivery/p/CON/team. No test covers this path, so a change that reads the effective role differently would let the real `getProject` throw ForbiddenError (a 500) while the suite stays green.

findings.message: The rules `.team-card>.card-head` and `.team-card>.card-head>.note`, plus their 600px media query, copy what delivery.css adds in this same diff for `.card-head.start` and `.card-head.start>.note`. The Team card's head already has the `start` class, so both copies apply to it and can drift apart. Delete the Allocations copy and keep the shared `.card-head.start` rules.
findings.scenario: Someone changes the note's font size in delivery.css. The Team card keeps 13px from allocations.css, and its head no longer matches the other project tabs.
